_comment: Display config for Sri Lanka. Coherence-only (Level 1): no BTR / BER / NR7 data, so no btrMitigationSourceRef, countrySectors, or mitigationTaxonomy. Document taxonomy and provenance drive the dashboard with no code changes (same shape as panama-country-config.json).
name: Sri Lanka
_anchorDocTypeComment: Intentionally omitted. anchorDocType drives the Vision Anchor Coverage view, which treats one document as the country's north-star/long-term vision that every other doc operationalises (Mongolia: Vision 2050 = SECTORAL). Sri Lanka's three documents (NDC, NBSAP, LDN) are parallel convention commitments (climate / nature / land), not a vision-and-derivatives hierarchy, so no anchor is set and that view stays off.
_documentTypesComment: Sri Lanka's three source documents from data_sri_lanka_15Jun26.xlsx. shortLabel / fullLabel come verbatim from the xlsx Doc and Document columns; the mediumLabel parenthetical is the verbatim Convention column value (Climate Change / Nature / Land degradation) so a reader sees the convention domain at a glance. Colors from the UNDP-compatible Tailwind palette: blue=climate, green=nature, amber=land. Avoids reserved red (#dc2626 political sensitivity), BTR purple (#7c3aed), and OTHER grey (#78716c); mutually distinguishable.

documentTypes.fullLabel: draft National Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan

_docProvenanceComment: Primary-source citations per document. The xlsx Source column was empty for every row, so citations name the document and country only; no URLs, dates, or other details are invented.
